title: Command envelope
description: Request body of every control subject (`oe.v1.{service}.control.…`), sent with NATS request/reply. The final element of `causal_path` must equal `command_id`; JSON Schema cannot say so, and `tooling/validate.py` checks it. Service schemas narrow `payload` with `allOf`.

expected_version.description: Accept only if the target resource is still at this version; otherwise reject with VERSION_CONFLICT. Only meaningful on subjects that name an existing resource.

deadline_at.description: Latest time the command may be accepted. A command not yet accepted by then is rejected with DEADLINE_EXCEEDED. The deadline never cancels work already accepted.

headers.description: NATS headers a command may carry: the sender's trace context.
